document_name: LPNs Missing on Manifest – Temporary Resolution

inbound.description: Identify missing LPNs by comparing mission lines and support headers.

procedures.procedure_name: LPNs Missing on Manifest – Temporary Resolution

query.sql: SELECT sex.SEX_SUPE, mil.MIL_SUPP, mil.OPE_NOOE, mil.MIE_NOMI, sex.SEX_NOMI, sex.SEX_NOOE FROM SEX_DAT sex JOIN MIL_DAT mil ON mil.ACT_CODE = sex.SEX_ACT AND mil.MIE_NoMI = sex.SEX_NoMI AND mil.MIL_SUPP = sex.SEX_SUPE WHERE sex.SEX_ACT = 'RSAJHBCLA' AND sex.SEX_NOOE = '0';

actions: Records returned indicate LPNs that will not appear on the manifest.
The issue is caused by a missing SEX_NOOE value.

steps.description: Temporary Fix: Update Missing Order Number

update.sql: UPDATE SEX_DAT SET SEX_NOOE = mil.OPE_NOOE FROM SEX_DAT sex JOIN MIL_DAT mil ON mil.ACT_CODE = sex.SEX_ACT AND mil.MIE_NoMI = sex.SEX_NoMI AND mil.MIL_SUPP = sex.SEX_SUPE WHERE sex.SEX_ACT = 'RSAJHBCLA' AND sex.SEX_NOOE = '0';

actions: SEX_NOOE is populated with the correct OPE_NOOE.
The LPN now correctly reflects on the manifest.

expected_outcome: SEX_NOOE is populated with the correct OPE_NOOE.
The LPN correctly reflects on the manifest.
important_notes: This is a temporary workaround, not a permanent fix.
Execute only when the issue is confirmed.
Database updates must be performed by Support.
Monitor recurring cases to assist with root cause analysis.

safety_rules: Always execute SELECT before performing any UPDATE.
Verify ACT_CODE and order number before updating.
